newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Heavyweights boost Bucharest bourse turnover.
newsitem.headline: Heavyweights boost Bucharest bourse turnover.

text.p: Bucharest bourse turnover edged up to 2.9 billion lei on Wednesday from a previous 2.7 billion with investor interest focusing again on the two stocks listed on the first tier.

Heavyweights Azomures SA fertiliser maker and chemical plant Oltchim SA accounted for 96 percent of the exchange's turnover. Azomures closed 100 lei higher at 1,610, while Oltchim was 10 lei weaker, ending at 1,390.
Traders said prices of Azomures and Oltchim might have peaked.
They said relative stability of the exchange rate of the leu currency over the past days had reduced bourse volatility.
Interest in the second-tier was thin due to low supply. Seven of the 24 small-caps listed on second-tier had no trade.
Another company, Terapia SA pharmaceutical plant, is expected to join second-tier trading on Thursday but traders were reluctant to forecast its evolution on the bourse floor.

Two unofficial indices -- the VAB and the BIG -- rose from the previous session by 2.5 percent and 2.4 percent respectively. The BIG first-tier index was 1,638.36 points, 2.24 percent up on the previous session.
The VAB index is displayed on VANGUARD.
